card.name: Overdose section wording and dialysis
card.fires_on: Words inside overdosage sections, such as 'available' after 'No experience with overdose is', 'to' after 'Dialysis is unlikely', and the end of 'hemodialysis'. Also fires on 'and' in a CYP3A4 and CYP2B6 list.

modes.label: Dialysis phrases
modes.description: The word 'to' after 'Dialysis is unlikely', or the ending of 'hemodialysis', in overdose text.
